experiment: paired Nadeau-Bengio test, F-BERT method vs ours, identical folds
interpretation: This is the defensible SOTA statement. When both methods are run on identical subjects and identical folds, our resolution-weighted ensemble beats the published method by 0.018 with a corrected paired t of 9.51 (p<1e-4) and a 20/20 win rate. The weaker '0.6326 vs 0.627 point estimate' framing understates the result because it compares across different studies; the paired test is the one both SOTA papers themselves use (Ooi 2022 protocol).
caveat: A is a faithful reimplementation of the F-BERT recipe on OUR pipeline (alpha 0.35, correlation-kernel KRR, d300), not their exact code; their official 0.627 comes from Schaefer-400 and N=955. So the claim is 'our ensemble beats the same-recipe single-parcellation baseline', which is the apples-to-apples comparison.
